children: MongoDB authorized an additional $1.0 billion share repurchase and presented new AI and platform innovations at its September 29 Investor Day.
Board approved $1.0B incremental repurchase, raising total authorization to $2.0B with $1,353,700,000 available.
Investor Day presentation detailed AI-focused product launches: MongoDB 9.0, Atlas Infinite and Atlas Agent Engine (public preview).
Company cited strong customer and Atlas momentum: 70K customers, consecutive Atlas net dollar growth and Atlas growth guidance of 20%+.
Updated near-term financial targets: total revenue growth 20%+, Atlas growth 20%+, operating margin expansion and GAAP profitability targeted in FY27.
Management highlighted AI adoption signals (vector search, Voyage AI, managed MCP server) and expected initial revenue from new products in FY28, with larger impact in FY29+.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: MongoDB adds $1.0B to buyback plan, unveils AI-driven product roadmap at Investor Day
